title: Evaluation-Protocol Leakage and Personalization in PPG-Based Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation: A Five-Architecture Study (code and results)
description: Code, trained model checkpoints, per-clip predictions and verification scripts for the manuscript "Evaluation-Protocol Leakage and Personalization in PPG-Based Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation: A Five-Architecture Study". The code (src/, scripts/, notebooks/) is released under the MIT License. Model checkpoints, predictions, metrics and figures were produced from PulseDB's VitalDB subset (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and are released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; see LICENSE-DATA.md. No PulseDB, VitalDB or PPG-DaLiA signals are included.
